D: A navy cook fights the terrorists who've taken over his battleship.
P: Serve dinner when Casey Ryback reveals he's just a cook.
S: Ryback's galley, before it all kicks off
Soft milk rolls: bread flour, milk, butter, sugar, yeast and an egg, proved twice, baked at 190C for 18 minutes, brushed with butter and flaky salt.
a taste of the captain's birthday dinner

Toasted baguette rubbed with garlic, spread with saffron and chilli rouille and topped with a poached prawn, fennel fronds and lemon zest. Soak a pinch of saffron in 1 tbsp hot water. Whisk 1 egg yolk with 1 crushed garlic clove, the saffron water, a pinch of chilli and 1 tsp lemon juice, then slowly whisk in 150ml olive oil until thick. Poach 16 peeled green prawns in simmering salted water for 2 minutes and cool. Slice a baguette into 16 pieces, toast at 200C for 6 minutes and rub with garlic. Spread with rouille, top with a prawn, fennel fronds and lemon zest.
the giant cake with a surprise inside
Vanilla sponge cut into small squares, split and filled with jam and cream, dusted with icing sugar.
M: the captain's birthday meal he was cooking

Fennel, leek, onion and garlic softened in olive oil with saffron, orange peel and tomato, fish stock simmered 20 minutes. Add firm fish, mussels and prawns in order, serve with rouille and toasted baguette.
Navy galley glazed meatloaf and mash

Beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, sliced thick over buttery mash with peas and onion gravy. Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 80ml milk. Mix with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and salt. Shape in a lined loaf tin. Mix 80ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar, spread on top and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml hot milk. Fry 1 sliced onion, stir in 1 tbsp flour and 300ml beef stock for gravy. Cook 300g frozen peas.
W: the surprise is that it's just cake this time
Two-layer vanilla butter cake with Swiss meringue buttercream, piped navy-style with "Happy Birthday Captain" in blue.
K: a sailor's drink aboard the Missouri

Dark rum and white rum shaken with lime, grapefruit and honey syrup, poured over crushed ice with a lime wheel and a dusting of nutmeg. Dissolve 2 tbsp honey in 2 tbsp hot water. Shake 90ml dark rum, 90ml white rum, 60ml fresh lime juice, 60ml grapefruit juice and the honey syrup with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers packed with crushed ice. Add a lime wheel to each and grate a little nutmeg on top.

edition.cue: Serve dinner when Casey Ryback reveals he's just a cook.

s.note: Soft milk rolls brushed with butter and flaky salt
s.how: Mix 500g bread flour, 7g yeast, 300ml warm milk, 50g butter, 2 tbsp sugar and 1 egg into a soft dough. Prove an hour, shape 12 rolls and prove 30 minutes more. Bake at 190C for 18 minutes and brush with butter and flaky salt.

s.note: Little squares of sponge with jam and cream
s.how: Cut a sponge cake into 16 small squares and split each in half. Whip 300ml cream to soft peaks. Fill each with a little raspberry jam and cream, put the tops back on and dust with icing sugar.

m.note: Saffron fish stew with rouille and toasted baguette
m.how: Soften 1 fennel, 1 leek, 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves in oil with saffron, orange peel and 1 tin tomatoes. Add 1L fish stock and simmer 20 minutes. Add 500g fish, then 500g mussels and 300g prawns. Serve with rouille and toasted baguette.

w.note: Vanilla layer cake piped Happy Birthday Captain in blue
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Beat 250g butter with 400g icing sugar, fill and cover the cake, then pipe the message in blue.

d.note: Dark rum and white rum shaken with lime, grapefruit and honey syrup, poured over crushed ice with a lime wheel and a dusting of nutmeg.
d.how: Dissolve 2 tbsp honey in 2 tbsp hot water. Shake 90ml dark rum, 90ml white rum, 60ml fresh lime juice, 60ml grapefruit juice and the honey syrup with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers packed with crushed ice. Add a lime wheel to each and grate a little nutmeg on top.
